empty.noTasks.title: Nothing on the list right now
empty.noTasks.body: That’s fine. Add something when you’re ready, or leave it quiet.
empty.noAnchors.title: No anchors yet
empty.noAnchors.body: Anchors are the small things that help you settle. You can set one up whenever it feels useful.
empty.restMode.title: Rest Mode is on
empty.restMode.body: No tasks. No nudges. Just space. Come back when you want to.
med.logged.title: Logged
med.notLogged.title: Not logged yet
med.notLogged.body: No rush. Log it when you take it, or skip if you’re not taking it today.
efficacy.comedownNudge.title: In about 45 minutes, things may ease
efficacy.comedownNudge.body: A gentle heads-up, not a warning. You might want a softer landing — water, a snack, or a slower pace.
task.complete.title: Done
task.complete.body: That’s one less thing holding on.
task.complete.alt3: Out of the way. On to whatever’s next — or nothing.
habit.skippedDay.title: A quiet day is still a day
habit.skippedDay.body: Nothing to catch up. You’re here now — that’s enough to start from.
habit.reset.title: Starting fresh from here
swap.prompt: This one isn’t landing. Want something gentler?
restMode.enter.title: Rest Mode
restMode.enter.body: You’re stepping back on purpose. Tasks and nudges pause until you say otherwise.
restMode.enter.confirm: Rest Mode is on. Take the space you need.
restMode.exit.title: Ready when you are
restMode.exit.body: Nothing piled up while you were away. Pick up only if you want to.
restMode.grounding.1: Feel your feet on the floor. That’s enough for now.
restMode.grounding.2: Unclench your jaw. Soften your shoulders. No rush.
restMode.grounding.3: Name three things you can see. You’re here.
restMode.grounding.4: One longer exhale than inhale. Then another, if you like.
restMode.grounding.5: Hand on chest or belly. Notice the rise and fall. You’re allowed to pause.
disclaimer.pkZones: These timing zones are a product model for organising the day — not medical advice, not a plasma prediction, and not a diagnosis. Placeholders follow a typical Concerta/OROS-class 18 mg pattern. UK “XL” is not one curve: Medikinet XL and Equasym XL often last around 8 hours. Comedown is highly individual. Your own experience comes first. Talk to a clinician about anything that concerns your medication or health.
